title: Part Seventeen: The Deal: Campaign Money to an Office

sections.brief: Sequence, not causation: endorsement 13 Jul 2024; Econ Club proposal 5 Sep 2024 (Musk to lead); $2T claim; >$290M; announcement 12 Nov 2024 ('dismantle Government Bureaucracy', outside government, 4 Jul 2026); WSJ op-ed 20 Nov ('outside volunteers', executive action, Loper Bright, West Virginia v. EPA); Andreessen recruiting; EO 14158 and Ramaswamy exit 20 Jan 2025; SGE 3 Feb; what the sequence does and does not show (public proposal, no document of exchange, 5 June boast, feud); RAGE rhyme not provenance; no Thiel role. Figures: time, flow

EO 14158 text (USDS rename in EOP, administrator to Chief of Staff, 5 USC 3161 temporary organization to 4 Jul 2026, DOGE teams, access clause, undefined data standards); SGE status; GAO-26-108403 (206/27/128, ethics records withheld, OGE no review); Fisher declaration, Gleason named 25 Feb and her declaration, Trump 'headed by Elon Musk', Chuang Appointments Clause and 4th Cir stay; FACA suits and status; FOIA: Cooper, SCOTUS 6 Jun 2025 order (not a FOIA exemption), cert No. 25-1103 (15 Oct 2026); Kupor Nov 2025; temporary org ended, USDS continues ($35M FY27); status as of Oct 2026; worst-case reading tested.
